name: Cua Lo beach
kicker: The long sand along Bình Minh
summary: Swim and walk the long sand at Cửa Lò, the beach of this city. Casuarina lines đường Bình Minh. The water is clear enough to see the sand, and the salinity is moderate. From the square it is 16 km east, 17 km, 18 km, or about 20 km. About 30 minutes by car is the Núi Cấm road for the 18 km. A chair is check on arrival. Skip it when the square is the only stop.
getThere: 16 km, 17 km, 18 km, or about 20 km from the square.
heroCaption: The sand at Cửa Lò, with coracles, the tree line, and an island offshore

notice.title: This square is not the one in town
notice.body: Quảng trường Bình Minh is on this sand. The statue square is in town, at Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi.

body: Swim and walk the sand. The shore is long, the water clear enough to see the sand, and the salinity moderate rather than harsh. Casuarina lines đường Bình Minh. The length is longer than 10 km, and also longer than 12 km.

From the square the beach is 16 km to the east, 17 km, 18 km, or about 20 km. About 30 minutes by car belongs to the Núi Cấm road and the 18 km. The other three distances have no paired minutes. Two city buses run out: Bến Thủy–Trường Thi–Cửa Hội–Cửa Lò, and Bến Thủy–Quang Trung–Quán Bánh–Cửa Lò. Fares are check on arrival.

From 1 December 2024 the old beach town is inside Vinh, and from 1 July 2025 the shore wards are phường Cửa Lò. Islands named off this shore are Ngư, Mắt, and Lan Châu, and also Song Ngư and Hòn Ngư. Keep those names apart. Cửa Hội is about 4 km farther, with a cable car longer than 3.5 km and chùa Song Ngư, more than 800 years old. A crossing time and a fare are check on arrival. Showers, public toilets, parking, and wifi were free for the 2025 season. A chair is check on arrival.

gettingThere: Four distances stay. It is 18 km and about 30 minutes by car on the Núi Cấm road, 17 km, 16 km to the east, and about 20 km. The sand runs along đường Bình Minh. The other three distances have no minutes.
From 1 December 2024 the former town is inside Vinh. From 1 July 2025 the beach wards are phường Cửa Lò. Cửa Hội is about 4 km on from the sand. A crossing time and a fare are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the square
legs.body: By car, or on the city buses Bến Thủy–Trường Thi–Cửa Hội–Cửa Lò and Bến Thủy–Quang Trung–Quán Bánh–Cửa Lò. Keep 16 km, 17 km, 18 km and about 30 minutes on the Núi Cấm road, and about 20 km. Bus fares are check on arrival.

admissionNote: No fee for the sand is set. Check on arrival. For the 2025 season, showers, public toilets, parking, and wifi were free. A chair is check on arrival.
